description: Owns POST /links with {code,destination} returning 201; GET /r/<code> returns 302 with Location=destination (404 for unknown), recording a timestamped click without contacting analytics; GET /events returns {events:[{code,destination,timestamp}]}. Publishes click_event.

Owns click storage and analytics queries independently. POST /collect with {} fetches GET /events using LINK_SERVICE_URL, deduplicates events and returns 200; GET /stats?code=<code> returns {code,clicks}. Never import link-service internals.
